prompt: What is the acceptable pressure limit for a Class 1 boiler according to OISD-STD-131?
response: Per OISD-STD-131 Section 3.2, the maximum allowable working pressure for a Class 1 boiler is 15.0 bar at design temperature.

prompt: Per OISD-STD-116, what fire protection facilities are mandatory for a petroleum refinery processing >5 MMTPA?
response: OISD-STD-116 requires: fire water reservoir (4 hrs capacity), hydrant system, monitors, foam system for tank farm, dedicated fire pumps (diesel + electric), jockey pump.

prompt: Describe the work permit system workflow for hot work in a hydrocarbon area per OISD-STD-105.
response: OISD-STD-105 workflow: 1) Area operator identifies need, 2) Gas testing (LEL <10%, O2 19.5-23.5%), 3) Permit issuer reviews and issues hot work permit, 4) Fire watch assigned, 5) Continuous gas monitoring during work, 6) Permit validity max 8 hrs, renewal requires re-test.

prompt: What is the required safety valve set pressure as a percentage of certified working pressure per API 510?
response: Per API 510 / ASME Section VIII, safety valve set pressure shall not exceed 100% of MAWP (Maximum Allowable Working Pressure). Accumulation allowed up to 110% MAWP for single valve, 116% for multiple valves.

prompt: List the inspection intervals for pressure vessel internal and external inspection per OISD-STD-131.
response: Per OISD-STD-131: External inspection every 2 years, Internal inspection every 4 years (or per RBI), Thickness monitoring per corrosion rate. Risk-Based Inspection (RBI) per API 581 may extend intervals.
